description: This file implements the MediaPipelineCapabilities class and related factory functions for media pipeline capabilities, including methods to check supported MIME types and create capabilities objects.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media pipeline capabilities, including supported MIME types and MIME type support checks.

methods.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory instance.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesFactory::createMediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a MediaPipelineCapabilities object.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities::MediaPipelineCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the capabilities object with a given GstCapabilitiesFactory.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities::getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types for a given media source type.

methods.name: MediaPipelineCapabilities::isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
